Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.a1: Yes. Bring a valid license or a 1949 Geneva International Driving Permit. No license, no ride.
Faq.a2: A racing suit and helmet are included. Premium character costumes can be added at booking.
Faq.a3: We meet at おおきに道頓堀ビル in Kozu, near Namba / Dotonbori. About 5 min walk from Namba Station.
Faq.a4: Light rain: raincoats provided, we usually still go. Heavy rain or typhoon: free reschedule or full refund.
Faq.q5: How old do I need to be?
Faq.a5: Drivers must be 18 or older with a valid license. Children may ride as passengers if a seat is available.
Faq.q6: Do I need an International Driving Permit?
Faq.a6: It depends on where your license was issued. US, Canada and Australia need a paper IDP booklet (categories A–E) or SOFA ID. Belgium, France, Germany, Monaco, Slovenia, Switzerland and Taiwan may use the original licence plus an official Japanese translation. Others need a 1949 Geneva IDP. Plastic cards are not accepted.
Faq.q7: Do you cancel when it rains?
Faq.a7: Light rain usually goes ahead, with raincoats. Heavy rain, typhoon, or official warnings: free reschedule or full refund. We reconfirm weather before departure.
Faq.q8: Are there height or weight limits?
Faq.a8: Drivers must be between 150 and 190 cm. Weight limits depend on the kart on the day. Staff will check the cockpit at check-in.
Faq.q9: Can I film with my phone while driving?
Faq.a9: Keep both hands on the wheel. Do not film while moving. Add a GoPro or pro photo follow if you want footage. Selfies are fine after you stop.
Faq.q10: How many people can go together?
Faq.a10: A slot is usually up to 4 karts. Bigger groups can split into back-to-back slots — message us and we will arrange it.

Notes.title: Booking notes
Notes.agreeLead: Tick each item to confirm you have read and agree.
Notes.openHint: License, height, clothing, restrictions, and cancellation
Notes.licenseBody: Bring your original licence, a paper International Driving Permit (IDP), and your passport. Plastic IDP cards are not accepted. Rules vary by country — read the full notes.
Notes.ageBody: Drivers must be 18 or older and between 150 and 190 cm. Children may ride as passengers if a seat is available. Child seats are not provided.
Notes.clothesBody: No high heels or long skirts. Wear comfortable clothes and closed-toe shoes. Helmets and safety gear are included.
Notes.weatherBody: Light rain: raincoats provided. Heavy rain or typhoon: free reschedule or full refund.
Notes.cancelBody: Free cancel 48 hours ahead. Within 48 hours: 50% refund. No-show: no refund. Invalid or missing IDP, or being refused for intoxication, is also non-refundable.
noticeItems: All drivers must be between 150 and 190 cm tall.
You must bring all three documents when driving: original driving licence, a paper International Driving Permit (IDP) issued by a local authority, and your passport.

Holders of US, Canadian or Australian passports must show an IDP or a US Forces SOFA ID. The IDP must be a booklet and list valid categories A–E. All participants must also show the original national licence and passport.

For Indian passport holders, the IDP is valid only if issued by: Western India Automobile Association, Upper India Automobile Association, Automobile Association of Eastern India, or Automobile Association of Southern India. The IDP must be a booklet with categories A–E. All participants must also show copies of their national licence and passport.

You need a valid Japanese licence, a Japan SOFA licence, or an IDP. Guests with licences from Belgium, France, Germany, Monaco, Slovenia, Switzerland or Taiwan may show the original licence plus an official Japanese translation from JAF or their embassy/consulate in Japan.

Guests from other countries must hold a 1949 Geneva Convention IDP. Taiwan guests must bring a Taiwan licence and a Japanese translation. If you cannot show both the licence and the official Japanese translation, you may be refused with no refund.
Notes.taiwanHint: For an official Japanese translation of a Taiwan licence, see the Taiwan Directorate General of Highways:
cautionItems: If your IDP is not valid in Japan, or you do not bring it, the tour will be cancelled with no refund.
Please arrive at least 20 minutes before the start time.
restrictItems: This activity is not suitable for guests with high blood pressure, epilepsy, heart disease, asthma or other serious conditions, or for pregnant guests, people with disabilities, or infants.
Anyone who appears intoxicated may be refused entry with no refund.
dressItems: Avoid high heels and long skirts — they interfere with driving.
Wear comfortable clothes and closed-toe shoes. Helmets and safety gear are provided.
accessItems: This activity is not suitable for strollers or wheelchairs.
weatherItems: Light rain: raincoats provided, tours usually run. Heavy rain or typhoon: free reschedule or full refund.
cancelItems: Free cancel 48 hours ahead. Within 48 hours: 50% refund. No-show: no refund. Licence issues, missing documents, or being refused for intoxication are also non-refundable.
